methods: Frozen E4 exclusions: drop entire group intersecting any listed verse in any Synoptic book.
Raw per-group greekAlignment only; no SUPPLEMENT. Both partners must lack Mark links. Original token-ID adjacency prevents bridging removed Scripture.
Single-word looser count includes qualifying words inside multiword runs, deduplicated by Matthew ID.

Apparatus: accent-insensitive substring search including function words; omission/addition units intersect matching printed NA28 token positions (insertion signs within two token slots), including spanning units. No witness interpretation.
Sort: descending content words, then length, then Matthew token IDs. First ten frozen for contextual review, not independently validated discoveries.
Lemma frequency: unique non-Scripture tokens in examined episodes, all three books, stratified by speech/narrative.
OpenGNT 3.3 (CC BY-SA 4.0); apparatus NA28, Deutsche Bibelgesellschaft. Editions differ.
